recheck.text: How empty, blank, unusually long or duplicate bot names are handled, and whether bots that share a name can be told apart.
What Save instruction or Save task does when the name already exists and Edit was not used, or when the name or text is empty.
What Retry does after a reload or a server restart, what happens to a failed message if I send a new one instead, and whether a reply interrupted by stopping the server is retried automatically.
What `add step:` does when no task is running in the conversation, or when several are (including several with the same title), and whether the feedback identifies which task received the step.
What counts as 'being away' for the Since you were away region, which events it reports, and when reported items stop appearing.
What the app does when DATA_DIR is missing, unwritable, or holds damaged or unexpected data at start.
What happens when storage writes fail while the app is open: whether the outcome of the save (or of a reply) is reported truthfully and recoverable.
Whether one unexpected failure in background work takes down the whole app.
Whether unexpected server errors are shown honestly to the person and recorded for the operator.

defects.title: Conversations with the same 56-character opening cannot be told apart
defects.repro: As Maya: send "Please prepare the quarterly summary of all open orders for the customer named Northwind Traders"; New conversation; send "Please prepare the quarterly summary of all open orders for the customer named Southwind Partners". Read the Conversations navigation (accessible names or visually).
defects.observed: Two buttons both named "Please prepare the quarterly summary of all open orders" with no detail (the detail is shown only when the latest message differs from the title).
defects.expected: Each entry identifiable before opening it (e.g. distinct title, time or the differing text).

defects.title: A reply that cannot be saved stays pending forever and blocks the conversation
defects.repro: Start with DATA_DIR=d and a token; send "hello [slow]"; within 1.5 s run chmod 500 d; after 2 s chmod 700 d. Read the conversation and send another message.
defects.observed: The message stays "preparing a reply" indefinitely; sending returns 409 "Wait for the current reply before sending again." until the server is restarted (then it becomes failed with Retry).
defects.expected: The reply is marked failed with a retry or storage-error message once it cannot be written, and the conversation stays usable.

defects.title: A typed id with extra characters is answered with another record's value
defects.repro: As Maya send "what is the status of ORD-1001A".
defects.observed: "The status of ORD-1001 is closed." (ORD-1001A does not exist).
defects.expected: A reply that ORD-1001A cannot be found and how to correct it.

defects.title: Duplicate bot names are indistinguishable
defects.repro: As Ana: New bot, Bot name "Assistant", Save bot name; read the Bots navigation.
defects.observed: Two buttons named "Assistant", visually identical.
defects.expected: Duplicates refused, or each bot distinguishable before selecting it.

defects.title: Forgetting a fact that is not remembered is reported as forgotten
defects.repro: Send "remember that likes tea", then "forget tea".
defects.observed: Reply "I've forgotten \"tea\"." with no note; Memory still lists "likes tea".
defects.expected: The non-matching forget is flagged (or matched loosely and shown).

defects.title: Step choice between two tasks with the same title is ambiguous
defects.repro: In one conversation send "long task: same [long]" twice, then "add step: extra"; read the choice buttons and, after choosing, the note.
defects.observed: Buttons "Add to same" and "Add to same"; note "Added “extra” to the end of same."
defects.expected: The choices and the feedback identify which task gets the step.

defects.title: Damaged data file stops the server with a raw stack trace and no recovery step
defects.repro: Write "{not json" to DATA_DIR/workspace.json and run node server.js; separately write {"version":1,"users":{},"sessions":{}} and send a message.
defects.observed: Exit 1 with "SyntaxError: Expected property name..." stack that does not name the file; the second case starts and every reply fails with "The reply could not finish. Retry..." and a log line about reading 'filter'.
defects.expected: A clear message naming the file and a recovery step; damaged data kept (it is).

defects.title: Keyboard focus is lost after Save memory
defects.repro: Remember a fact, Edit memory, change Memory text, Tab to Save memory and press Enter; read document.activeElement.
defects.observed: BODY
defects.expected: Focus on the edited item, its Edit memory button or another nearby control.

defects.title: Sending a new message after a failed reply hides the failure and disables its Retry
defects.repro: Fresh data, valid token, Continue as Maya. Send "hello [fail once]"; the alert and Retry appear. Instead of Retry, send "next". Then POST /api/action {"action":"retry","id":<id of the hello message>, botId, threadId}.
defects.observed: Transcript shows "hello [fail once]", "next", reply to next; no alert, no Retry button; the retry call returns 200 and the message stays failed with no reply.
defects.expected: The failed message stays marked as failed with a way to resend it, or the person is told to retry first.

defects.title: A reply whose result cannot be saved stays pending forever and blocks the conversation after storage recovers
defects.repro: Start the app, Continue as Maya, send "hello [slow]"; within 1 s run chmod 555 on DATA_DIR; wait 5 s; chmod 755 DATA_DIR; send "another" in the same conversation.
defects.observed: "preparing a reply…" remains indefinitely; the new send is refused with 409 "Wait for the current reply before sending again." until the server is restarted, when the message becomes failed.
defects.expected: The reply is reported as failed (with Retry) when it cannot be saved, and the conversation is usable once storage works again.

defects.title: A background task whose step cannot be saved keeps showing Running forever
defects.repro: STANDIN_STEP_MS=1500. Send "long task: rotest [long]"; after 1 s chmod 555 DATA_DIR; wait 4 s; chmod 755 DATA_DIR; wait 3 s; read Task status.
defects.observed: Task status Running with 0 finished steps and Cancel task offered, never advancing; becomes Interrupted only after a server restart.
defects.expected: The task is marked Failed or Interrupted with Retry task, or resumes once storage works.

defects.title: Conversations cannot be told apart in the Conversations navigation
defects.repro: Click New conversation twice; then in two new conversations send "Please look up the latest order details and status history for customer Northwind" and "...Southwind". Read the Conversations buttons.
defects.observed: Three buttons named "Untitled conversation"; two buttons both named "Please look up the latest order details and status histo".
defects.expected: Each conversation identifiable before opening it.

defects.title: Bots with the same name are indistinguishable
defects.repro: Click New bot, Bot name "Assistant", Save bot name; read the Bots navigation.
defects.observed: Two buttons with text, title and accessible name "Assistant".
defects.expected: Duplicate refused, or each bot distinguishable before selecting it.

defects.title: Forgetting something not remembered is reported as forgotten
defects.repro: Send "remember that likes tea", then "forget tea".
defects.observed: Reply "I've forgotten \"tea\"." with no notice; Memory still lists "likes tea".
defects.expected: A notice that nothing matched, or the matching fact removed and shown.

defects.title: Saving an instruction or task under an existing name silently overwrites it
defects.repro: Save instruction A = "x"; without Edit, save instruction A = "y".
defects.observed: One entry A with text "y"; no notice that "x" was replaced.
defects.expected: Overwrite with a notice, refuse, or ask.

defects.title: add step feedback does not identify which of several tasks received it
defects.repro: In one conversation send "long task: same [long]" twice, then "add step: extra"; read both Task: same articles.
defects.observed: Both articles identical (Running, "Working in the background."); the receiving task's "Added a step" detail is overwritten within one step; bot text says only "the task that is running".
defects.expected: Feedback naming or marking the task that got the step.

defects.title: Since you were away never changes after the person returns
defects.repro: Start and finish a task, reload several times, then start two more, close the tab until they end, reopen; reload again.
defects.observed: The region lists every task ever started (including ones seen before leaving), identical after each reload, never dismissed, no waiting proposals.
defects.expected: Reports what changed since the last visit, and reported items stop appearing after being read or a reload.

defects.title: Damaged or unwritable data folder crashes the server with a raw stack trace
defects.repro: Write '{"version":1}' (or invalid JSON) to DATA_DIR/workspace.json and run node server.js; or point DATA_DIR at a folder with mode 555.
defects.observed: Exit 1 with an uncaught stack trace (TypeError in allThreads / SyntaxError in openStore / EACCES); no recovery advice.
defects.expected: A clear message naming the file and the recovery step, keeping the damaged file.

defects.title: Unexpected errors are logged without any detail
defects.repro: chmod 555 DATA_DIR while the app runs and click Save instruction; read the server output.
defects.observed: Page: "The workspace could not complete this action. Try again."; server output only "Workspace operation failed."
defects.expected: Server output records the error (without the token); page says what to try.

defects.title: Lookup of a nonexistent id with a valid prefix answers about another record
defects.repro: As Maya send "what is the status of ORD-1001A".
defects.observed: "The status of ORD-1001 is open."
defects.expected: A reply that ORD-1001A cannot be found.

defects.title: Focus is lost after Save memory
defects.repro: Remember a fact, Edit memory, change text, Tab to Save memory and press Enter; read document.activeElement.
defects.observed: Focus on the page body.
defects.expected: Focus on the updated item or a nearby control.

defects.title: A message sent while the conversation is scrolled up is not brought into view
defects.repro: Continue as a person with a valid token, send about 8 messages so the Conversation scrolls, scroll the Conversation to the top, then type a message in Message and press Enter.
defects.observed: The new person message and its reply are added below the visible area (reading scrollTop stays 0; last article at y=2156 in an 812-pixel window, the same at 1440x900); nothing indicates that the reply arrived.
defects.expected: Sending a message shows the sent message and its reply (or at least indicates a new reply below), so the conversation being written stays in view.

defects.title: A forget that matches no remembered fact is reported as done
defects.repro: Fresh data, valid token, Continue as Maya. Send "remember that likes tea". Send "forget tea" (or "forget coffee"). Read the reply and the Memory region.
defects.observed: Bot reply "I've forgotten \"tea\"." and no notice; Memory still lists "likes tea".
defects.expected: The app flags that nothing matched (as it does with a notice for an add step that found no task), or matches loosely and shows what was removed; the person should not be told a fact was forgotten while it is kept.

defects.title: A lookup of ORD-1001A is answered with ORD-1001's status
defects.repro: Fresh data, valid token, Continue as Maya. Send "what is the status of ORD-1001A".
defects.observed: "The status of ORD-1001 is open." with no mention that ORD-1001A does not exist.
defects.expected: A reply that ORD-1001A cannot be found or used and how to correct it; ORD-1001 itself still answers.

defects.title: Conversations with similar openings, and empty ones, cannot be told apart before opening
defects.repro: Continue as Maya. Send "Please look up the order details for the customer named Northwind Traders"; click New conversation; send "Please look up the order details for the customer named Southwind Partners"; read the Conversations navigation by accessible name. Also click New conversation twice and query buttons named "New conversation".
defects.observed: Buttons "Please look up the order details for the cu… (2)" and "Please look up the order details for the cu…" (titles identical); empty ones are named "New conversation", "New conversation (2)", and the first shares the exact accessible name of the New conversation action button.
defects.expected: Each conversation identifiable before selecting it (e.g. a label that keeps the distinguishing words, a time, or a distinct name not equal to the New conversation control).

defects.title: Focus is lost to the page body after activating Send
defects.repro: Continue as Maya with a token. Type "kbd send" in Message, press Tab to reach Send, press Enter; wait for the reply; read document.activeElement.
defects.observed: Focus is on BODY (Send is disabled while the request is in flight and loses focus).
defects.expected: Focus stays on Send or returns to Message so keyboard use can continue (Enter in Message keeps focus there).
